## Page 1
RiskGPT: The Enterprise azs Platform for Regulated Work at BMO
RiskGPT was built to solve a problem productivity AI cannot solve:
In regulated environments, producing an answer is not enough —
the answer must be prasasovable.
Where Microsoft Copilot helps individuals work faster,
RiskGPT helps the bank operate smarter.
RiskGPT connects to internal data, automates regulated workflows, stores lineage, and produces
evidence-backed output that can withstand audit, model validation, and regulatory examination.
Copilot drafts. RiskGPT proves.
The Work That Runs the Bank Is Not Linear — It’s Investigative
Analysts and managers spend hours navigating SQL/parquet datasets, 200-page OSFI/SEC policy
documents, SharePoint repositories of audit evidence, and Jira change logs.
RiskGPT does not replace expertise — it eliminates the searching,
assembling, reconciling, and proving.
You think fi RiskGPT executes.
MCP — Model Context Protocol (Internal Data Connectivity)
Most AI tools hallucinate because they guess.
RiskGPT does not guess — it connects.
Through MCP, RiskGPT plugs into BMO internal systems:
- Parquet and SQL tables
- SharePoint and Confluence
- Jira and ticketing workflows
